items.source: Using this interface on a registered bean will cause the bean and all of its dependencies to be initialized during AOT processing. We generally recommend that this interface is only used with infrastructure beans such as BeanFactoryPostProcessor which have limited dependencies and are already initialized early in the bean factory lifecycle. If such a bean is registered using a factory method, make sure to make it static so that its enclosing class does not have to be initialized.
items.translation: 在此接口上使用该接口的已注册 Bean 将导致该 Bean以及其所有依赖项在 AOT 处理期间进行初始化。我们通常建议仅将此接口用于基础设施 Bean，例如BeanFactoryPostProcessor，这些 Bean 具有有限的依赖项，并且已在 Bean 工厂生命周期早期初始化。如果此类 Bean 是使用工厂方法注册的，请确保将其声明为static，以便无需初始化其外部类。

items.source: BeanFactoryInitializationAotProcessor implementations may be registered in a "META-INF/spring/aot.factories"<T> resource or as a bean.
items.translation: BeanFactoryInitializationAotProcessor 实现可以注册在 "META-INF/spring/aot.factories"<T> 资源中，或作为 Bean。

items.source: If the given bean factory does not contain anything that is relevant to the processor, this method should return a null contribution.
items.translation: 如果给定的 BeanFactory 不包含与处理器相关的内容，此方法应返回一个null贡献。

items.source: A component that implements this interface is not contributed.
items.translation: 实现该接口的组件未贡献。

items.source:
Processors are free to use any techniques they like to analyze the given
bean factory. Most typically use reflection to find fields or methods to
use in the contribution. Contributions typically generate source code or
resource files that can be used when the AOT optimized application runs.
items.translation: 处理器可以自由使用任何技术来分析给定的 Bean 工厂。大多数处理器通常使用反射来查找用于贡献的字段或方法。贡献通常会生成源代码或资源文件，这些文件可在 AOT 优化后的应用程序运行时使用。

items.source: Process the given ConfigurableListableBeanFactory instance ahead-of-time and return a contribution or null.
items.translation: 提前处理给定的ConfigurableListableBeanFactory实例，并返回贡献结果或null。
beanFactory - 要处理的 Bean 工厂

items.source: This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个功能接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。
